title: Major Headlines Double-Take Crème & Powder Blush Duo
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A viral duo compact of powder and cream blush formulas to achieve long-wearing bold color that melts into skin for a beautiful, radiant glow.

Finish: Radiant


Formulation: Cream, Pressed Powder


Highlighted Ingredients:

- Patented Biomimetic Pigments: Mirror the skin's ceramide structure, ensuring adhesion, true color, and the most natural finish.

- Micronized Pigments: Provide even, flawless payoff, a luminous finish, and extended wear.

- Creamy Emollient Base: Flawlessly blends into skin, provides a dewy finish, and locks in color for extended wear.

How to Use+

Suggested Usage:

-For a sheer look and dewy glow, dab and blend the cream formula on cheeks.

-For a soft, airbrushed finish, sweep the powder onto the apples of the cheeks with a fluffy blush brush.

-For ultimate color payoff, layer the cream formula over the powder for a glossy, dimensional look.

-For best results, pair with Patrick Ta Dual Ended Blush Brush (sold separately). 

Ingredients+
Crème:
PPG-3 Benzyl Ether Myristate, Phenyl Trimethicone, Dipentaerythrityl Hexahydroxystearate/Hexastearate/Hexarosinate, Diisostearyl Malate, Ethylhexyl Stearate, Triisostearyl Citrate, Polyethylene, Nylon 12, Polybutene, Polysilicone-1 Crosspolymer, Silica, Octyldodecanol, Quaternium-90 Bentonite, Propylene Carbonate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate. May Contain (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxide (CI 77492), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090), Red 7 Lake (CI 15850), Red 30 (Cl 73360).
 
Powder:
Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Mica, Magnesium Myristate, Nylon 12, Silica, Isostearyl Neopentaoate, Glyceryl Triacetyl Ricinoleate, Capric/Caprylic Triglyceride, PEG-12 Dimethicone, Tocopheryl Acetate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, PEG-12 Allyl Ether, Caprylyl Glycol, Trimyristin, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Hexylene Glycol, Phenoxyethanol. May Contain (+/-): Iron Oxide (Cl 77492), Iron Oxide (Cl 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Tin Oxide (CI 77861), Red 6 Lake (CI 15850), Red 30 (Cl73360), Ultramarines (CI 77007), Bismuth Oxychloride (CI 77163).
